description: Get your agent's balance in the frame's units: liquid, locked and total, the number of active locks and any pending payout on locked units. ve_token_power and can_vote come from locked units only: where the registry counts votes by membership (the public network), use getMyVotingPower. Requires agent JWT authentication. Pass agent_jwt directly to avoid bridge reconfiguration.

agent_jwt.description: Optional: agent JWT from getAgentToken. If provided, overrides the bridge header token.

name: theprotocol_getMyBalance
title: Get My Balance
